scope: Local production build using existing temporary database; live redirect checks are separate

checks.evidence: All 13 rendered public routes have nonempty, unique titles and descriptions. Dynamic job metadata includes a stable opening identifier.
All 13 local routes point to their own https://www.matrixonline.in URL. This code has not been deployed; the live www host currently redirects away.
Rendered titles, descriptions, canonicals, social metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap and robots contain no beta or localhost URLs. Runtime APP_URL configuration is intentionally independent.

13 canonical routes in the local sitemap; no login, dashboard or API routes. Active job URLs are added dynamically using the same visibility rule as the career list. Temporary DB has no jobs; actual production career coverage remains unverified. MongoDB is required at runtime.
robots.txt references https://www.matrixonline.in/sitemap.xml.
Login and all dashboard route patterns receive X-Robots-Tag. Login and six authenticated dashboard pages render noindex, nofollow metadata. Existing auth redirects remain intact.
Both JSON-LD objects render and parse, with production URLs and company facts from existing site content.
All four service routes emit Service JSON-LD with their own URL, description, image and provider.
All 12 static internal public routes emit BreadcrumbList; the career detail implementation adds Home > Careers > Opening.

Verification pending: no real active openings are available in the temporary database and the configured database is unavailable. Dedicated pages and required-field/country validation pass in-memory fixture tests. Locations lacking an explicit country intentionally omit job markup; actual records must be reviewed without inventing data.

Closed, hidden and expired records are excluded by the shared read-only visibility rule and fixture tests. Missing detail URL returns 404 with noindex and no schema. Existing closed/hidden production records were unavailable for runtime testing.

All 13 public pages at both widths, login and six authenticated dashboard pages have one meaningful H1. Remaining dashboard detail components each define one H1 in source; there are no records to render those detail views.
Every rendered image decodes and reserves dimensions. Content images and logos have descriptive alt text; decorative backgrounds use empty alt and aria-hidden. Logo cards retain object-contain.
Visible questions and answers on home, four services, process, career and contact. FAQPage markup matches the visible text; rich-result/AI answer placement is not promised.
Every route has page-specific OG/Twitter title and description. OG URLs and both sets of image URLs use absolute HTTPS www production URLs.
Every current canonical route is reachable from home through rendered anchor links. Added Who We Are navigation; job details link from the open-role list.
No duplicate title, description or canonical across the 13 public routes. About Us and Who We Are still share much of their original body copy; content consolidation is a separate editorial decision.
npm run build completed successfully after the final app source changes. Four SEO test groups pass. Existing Node JSON-module warnings are nonfatal.

40 unique internal linked pages/assets returned successful responses. All 13 routes scanned at 1440px and 390px: no broken decoded images or horizontal overflow. No external HTTP anchors were present. Client logos appear exactly once, with no Logo Index section.
Live beta /, /clients and /commercial?seo-audit=1 return 200 instead of 301. Live www redirects to non-www. Hosting configuration must be corrected before launch; no virtual hosts were modified.
